messages:
Kai (partnerships): Quick alert — platform will deprecate the legacy SDK adapter endpoint (/v1/sdk-adapt) on 2026-06-10. Need partner comms, migration options, and rollback checklist.
Ivy (platform): Thanks. Migration options: (A) SDK patch (minor) for partners who can ship quickly; (B) marketplace-hosted shim we run for partners needing more time; (C) gateway rewrite for a short transition window. We'll provide header mapping and a small compat client.
Jon (integrations): I'll pull the impacted partner list (marketplace vendors, OEMs, SIs). Please share exact param/header diffs so I can include step-by-step scripts in the migration doc.
Priya (eng): FYI technical bits: old endpoint used X-SDK-Compat and altered stream envelopes. New API uses /v2/generate with X-RW-Mode: compat. KV-cache keys unchanged, but query param names change. We'll add transparent mapping for 4 weeks and add smoke tests.
Kai (partnerships): Action items: partner email + migration guide, tracker with priority tiers, and scheduled office hours for top partners.
Ivy (platform): Proposed timeline: announce 2026-04-12, start transparent rewrites 2026-04-26, partner canaries 2026-05-04, retire shim 2026-06-10. I'll own the canary dashboard and rollback toggle.
Jon (integrations): I'll reach out to CloudBridge and HardwareX for early canary slots. Tagging partners who need managed migration in the tracker.
Priya (eng): Snippet for partners to test locally:
```
# old
curl -H "X-SDK-Compat: true" https://api.redwood.com/v1/sdk-adapt/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
# new
curl -H "X-RW-Mode: compat" https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
We'll publish small patches for python/js/go and an npm compat package.
NotifyBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PART-900 for sdk-adapt sunset, patches, docs, and outreach.
Kai (partnerships): Great. Also build a rollback checklist: 1) toggle gateway rewrite on; 2) activate marketplace shim for affected partners; 3) notify partner success leads; 4) open an incident channel if >5 partners hit errors. Add checklist to the epic.
Ivy (platform): Will do. Next sync: Mon 2026-04-15 10:00 PT. Tracker -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PART-900 :thumbsup:
Jon (integrations): :thumbsup:
Priya (eng): lgtm
